title: PNGRB Graded Its Own Homework on the 2025-26 Plan. Its Own Numbers Undercut the Cover Letter.

version_history.note: Publish two new posts sourced from PNGRB's Sept 2026 Action Taken Report on the Annual Plan 2025-26: (1) a scorecard piece checking the ATR's own 'achieved'/'operationalised' language against the numbers it discloses two sentences later (Common Carrier 2/43, billing compliance 49%, CBG-CGD hookup 17/~130, Ombudsman still unstaffed 5 months after the Consumer Protection Regulations took effect); (2) a focused CBG-CGD connectivity piece (SATAT's original 5,000-plant target vs 132 commissioned vs 17 pipeline-connected). Also updated the earlier 'India's Gas Pipelines Run at Half Capacity' post with primary-source confirmation of the 75%-long-term-contracting/Pipeline Development Reserve mechanism it had previously only sourced via search snippets.
